description.en: A Codex-inspired bundle for DeepSeek Harness shipped as one npm package: 18 independently switchable plugins covering selection quotes, side conversations, Git worktree environments with setup scripts, code review, and session management. The bundle manifest composes the child packages, a Settings page lists every feature with its own toggle, and each child package is pinned to an exact version so a single install or upgrade moves the whole set.
description.zh: 把 Codex 的交互方式搬进 DSH 的插件合集，一个 npm 包装齐 18 项可独立启停的增强：选中引用、侧边对话、带初始化脚本的 Git 工作树环境、代码审查与会话整理。合集清单负责组合各子包，设置页列出每个功能并提供独立开关，子包按精确版本锁定，一次安装或升级即整体更新。
